items.docs:
Create an external resource for a resource. Attributes set on the external
resource override the attributes of the related resource. Attributes left
null on the external resource will fall back to the related resource.

**Access**: The current user must be an admin of the space the resource belongs to.

params.name: include
params.description:
List of related resources to include in response.
`media` are the additional photos of a resource (the primary photo is
in the `photo` attribute).

items.docs:

params.description: The id of the external resource.

items.docs:

Delete an external resource. The original resource the external resource is connected to is not deleted.

**Access**: The current user must be an admin of the space.

items.docs:
See the times an external resource is still available to book. Considers existing
bookings, the resource's booking times and calendar blockers.

**Access**: Any user can access any space's external resources.

params.name: spaceId
params.description: The id of the space to get the resources for.

params.name: include
params.description:
List of related resources to include in response.
`media` are the additional photos of a resource (the primary photo is
in the `photo` attribute).

items.docs:
List the resources enabled for external booking for a space.

These resources can be booked and paid for by non-members of a space.

**Access**: Any user can access any space's external resources.

params.name: spaceId
params.description: The id of the space to get the resources for.

params.name: filter[from]
params.description: The start of the timespan to check for availability.

params.name: filter[to]
params.description: The end of the timespan to check for availability.

params.name: filter[ignoreBookingTimes]
params.description: If set to true, returns resources as available even when the requested time is outside of the resource's booking times setting or blocked by calendar blockers. Option available only for admins of a space.

params.name: filter[ignoreExternalBookingId]
params.description:
Id of an external booking to not consider when determining
availability. Useful for determining availbility before moving an
external booking to a different time.

params.name: filter[minimumCapacity]
params.description: If set, returns only resources where capacity is greater than or equal to requested value.

params.name: include
params.description:
List of related resources to include in response.
`media` are the additional photos of a resource (the primary photo is
in the `photo` attribute).

items.docs:
List the external resources that are available to book at a given time.
This means there are fewer existing bookings than the resources' units.
`booking_times`, min/max duration and calendar blockers are also taken into account.

**Access**: Any user can access any space's external resources.
